current.title: Round 72 DELIVERED — the adaptive capability round (0.72.0)
current.detail: The owner's directive 'proper detailed system prompts which the agent accesses when required and on the basis of the task, various in-built skills' turned into four disjoint workstreams. (1) Task hints: NEW agents/task-hints.ts — a deterministic (no-LLM, zero-cost, zero-latency) matcher scoring the turn's user message against the effective skills' trigger-rich descriptions (quoted phrases ×5, stopword-filtered tokens +1, top-2 above threshold); the SKILLS prompt section renders one advisory 'Task signal: this request looks like it matches **<name>** — consider calling read_skill FIRST' line; both turn paths; per-turn ephemeral; flows through resolveEffectiveSkills (computer-use gate + agent allowlist); golden fixture byte-identical. (2) Skills 12→18: six engineering-craft builtins (tdd, api-design, frontend-craft, typescript-craft, security-review, refactoring — sortOrder 12-17, INSERT OR IGNORE, descriptions 447-490 chars, bodies 1.6-1.9K, iron laws + output blocks). (3) References depth: file skills gain a references/ subdirectory (the Agent-Skills standard: one level, ≤8 .md files ≤64KB); read_skill's optional reference param loads them (listing block with copy-pasteable syntax, traversal-sanitized, honest caps); GET /skills carries the metadata additively. (4) Per-directory conventions: NEW tools/dir-conventions.ts — read_file appends a capped (2K) fenced '[conventions from <dir>/AGENTS.md]' reminder when the deepest AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md strictly below root governs the file (root skipped — already in the system prompt; once per session+dir). Verification: 2423 root tests in 133 files, all green (agent-core 1521/1521 in 70 files, frontend 890 unchanged, e2e 12; +136 = four new suites 27+32+27+20 + re-pins r71-skills-round 51→75 / r70-skills-system 45→51), lint/typecheck clean, license audit CLEAN (134 deps). The live gates (the task-signal line on real messages, the six skills' triggers, references loading, nested-dir reminders on real repos) await the owner's Windows field run. Next: the R73 queue — delegate_task task_id/background/resume, the generalized system-reminder injector, custom modes (.acute/agents/*.md), external plugin ctx enrichment, two more skills (performance, spec-planning).
